game_concept: A racing platformer set in Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane, a lane of furriers: the sled courier must handle icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Boolean Guards: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints.
theme: Snowy Hold – Furrier Lane: a lane of furriers
core_gameplay_loop: In Furrier Lane, repeat each round: Write functions returning True or False that guard checkpoints. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the sled courier ahead. Then check the guards value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the ice mill by solving code steps involving guards that move the sled courier forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the ice mill first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Boolean Guards
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Guards' (Week 6 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Furrier Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how guards changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against icicle bats in Furrier Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
